sql: CREATE SCHEMA other
CREATE TABLE other.o (id int PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE base (id int PRIMARY KEY, grp int, r int4range, EXCLUDE USING gist (r WITH &&))
CREATE TABLE kid (id int PRIMARY KEY, base_id int, o_id int, FOREIGN KEY (base_id) REFERENCES base(id) MATCH FULL, FOREIGN KEY (o_id) REFERENCES other.o(id))
CREATE TABLE parted (id int, day date) PARTITION BY RANGE (day)
CREATE TABLE parted_2020 PARTITION OF parted FOR VALUES FROM ('2020-01-01') TO ('2021-01-01')
ALTER TABLE base ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER dummy_fdw
CREATE SERVER dummy_srv FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER dummy_fdw
CREATE FOREIGN TABLE ft (a int) SERVER dummy_srv
CREATE TABLE marked (id int PRIMARY KEY, v text)
COMMENT ON COLUMN marked.v IS 'datatug:{"src":"sqlite","type":"NVARCHAR(10)"}'
CREATE TABLE badmarked (id int PRIMARY KEY, v text)
COMMENT ON COLUMN badmarked.v IS 'datatug:not json'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sqlite_autoindex_marked_1 ON marked (v)
ALTER TABLE marked ADD COLUMN d2 uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
CREATE TABLE seqs (id serial PRIMARY KEY, v text)
INSERT INTO seqs (v) VALUES ('a')
INSERT INTO base VALUES (1, 1, '[1,3)')

SELECT c.oid::bigint, c.relname, c.relkind::text, c.relispartition, c.relrowsecurity FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') ORDER BY c.relname

SELECT a.attnum, a.attname, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod), tt.typname, tt.typtype::text, tt.typcategory::text, a.attnotnull, COALESCE(pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid), ''), a.attidentity::text, a.attgenerated::text, COALESCE(col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum), ''), (a.attcollation <> 0 AND a.attcollation <> tt.typcollation) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_type tt ON tt.oid = a.atttypid LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum WHERE a.attrelid = $1 AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY a.attnum

SELECT c.conname, c.contype::text, (SELECT string_agg(a.attname, E'\037' ORDER BY k.ord) FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(n, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND a.attnum = k.n), COALESCE(rn.nspname, ''), COALESCE(rc.relname, ''), (SELECT string_agg(a.attname, E'\037' ORDER BY k.ord) FROM unnest(c.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(n, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.confrelid AND a.attnum = k.n), c.confupdtype::text, c.confdeltype::text, c.condeferrable, c.condeferred, c.convalidated, pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid), c.confmatchtype::text FROM pg_constraint c LEFT JOIN pg_class rc ON rc.oid = c.confrelid LEFT JOIN pg_namespace rn ON rn.oid = rc.relnamespace WHERE c.conrelid = $1 ORDER BY c.conname

SELECT ic.relname, i.indisunique, am.amname, i.indpred IS NOT NULL, COALESCE(pg_get_expr(i.indpred, i.indrelid), ''), i.indnkeyatts, i.indnatts, (SELECT string_agg(CASE WHEN k.n = 0 THEN '' ELSE a.attname END, E'\037' ORDER BY k.ord) FROM unnest(i.indkey::int2[]) WITH ORDINALITY k(n, ord) LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = i.indrelid AND a.attnum = k.n), array_to_string(i.indoption::int2[], ','), i.indexprs IS NOT NULL, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.conindid = i.indexrelid AND c.contype IN ('p','u','x')) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = ic.relam WHERE i.indrelid = $1 ORDER BY ic.relname
